'''Futebol Clube de Arouca''' ({{IPA|pt|ɐˈɾokɐ|pron}}) is a professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Arouca, Portugal|Arouca]], in the [[Porto metropolitan area]]. Founded in 1951, the club plays in the [[Primeira Liga]], holding home games at [[Estádio Municipal de Arouca]], with a 5,600-seat capacity."}}
